name: Zinzolin
lede: Zinzolin is a deep reddish purple whose name's origin our sources do not document.

sections.title: Origin undocumented
sections.body:
Our data files Zinzolin from Wikipedia's color lists alone, with no discovery date, person or place attached to the word [1]. It sits deep in the purple family, close to magenta [1].

The nearest look-alikes are [[seance]], 5.0 units away and purpler, and [[dark-magenta]], 6.1 units away, lighter and more vivid; [[eminence]] follows at 6.4, duller and lighter [2]. Rather than guess at a history we cannot check, we report what the data actually shows: a hex value, a family, and its nearest named neighbors, and leave the word's deeper past undocumented [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive holds enough of this exact color to count as present, as photographed, so we have no century, painter or role data for it [3]. That reflects the limits of our archive's palette, not a claim about the color itself [3].
